observations: White plastic tank enclosed in a grey metal cage, standard IBC (intermediate bulk container) tote shape.
Blue plastic valve/spigot visible at the base in photos 0 and 1.
A red/white warning-style sticker is visible near the valve in photo 1, text not legible.
A barcode sticker is visible on the top cage bar in photo 1, not legible.
Photo 2 shows embossed lettering on the plastic body, partially reading something like '1000' and '250-L', obscured by cage bars and watermark.
Other similar totes are visible in the background of all three photos, suggesting a stock/yard of multiple units.
Plastic pallet-style base visible at the bottom of the cage in photo 0.
No visible cracks, stains, or chemical residue inside the tank; interior cannot be seen through opaque plastic.

identity.kind: IBC tote / industrial bulk liquid container

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals
claims.evidence: No certification plate, UN rating code, or chemical-compatibility label is legible in any photo; the red sticker in photo 1 cannot be read.

claims.claim: Implied capacity around 1000 liters (standard IBC size)
claims.evidence: Embossed numbers in photo 2 are partly visible but obscured by the cage and watermark, so the exact liter rating cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Tank could have stored hazardous or contaminated material previously, making it unsafe for food-grade or sensitive reuse.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the full hazard/UN certification sticker and any prior-use label, unobstructed by cage bars.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown prior-use / non food-grade, lowest tier use case

risks.risk: Valve or spigot may be cracked, stuck, or leaking.
risks.proof: Short video clip of the valve being opened and water flowing through it.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional valve, needing replacement

risks.risk: Plastic inner tank may have UV degradation, stress cracks, or micro-fractures not visible in these angles.
risks.proof: Full 360° photos including the base, underside, and top dome in daylight.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural condition unknown, worst case cracked

risks.risk: Metal cage may be rusted or bent at joints, weakening structural support when filled.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of cage weld points and corners, especially at the base.

risks.risk: Actual liter capacity unconfirmed, affecting per-liter value.
risks.proof: Unobstructed close-up of the embossed capacity marking or a manufacturer data plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced at smallest common IBC size assumption (worst case)

proof_requests: Clear, unobstructed photo of the full hazard/certification sticker and any embossed capacity plate.
Video of the valve opening and liquid flow to confirm it works.
Full exterior photos from all four sides plus top and base, in good light, showing no cracks or rust.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard used IBC tote by type, but none of the seller's suitability or capacity claims can be confirmed from the photos, so it must be priced at the worst-case condition (unverified capacity, unverified valve function, unknown prior contents) until better proof is supplied.
